prompt: `mypy` (strict mode, configured in `pyproject.toml`) reports errors in `src/`. Fix them so that `mypy` passes, without `# type: ignore`, `cast`, `Any`, or changes to the mypy configuration.
bash_commands: cat -n src/trailhead/elevation.py && echo ---- && cat -n src/trailhead/pace.py && echo ---- && cat -n src/trailhead/report.py && echo ---- && ls -R src tests 2>/dev/null | head -50
cat -n src/trailhead/track.py && echo ---- && grep -rn "ele" tests/ src/ | grep -v "elevation\|elevations" | head -40; echo ----; git log --oneline | head; git status --short
grep -rn "None\|lost\|gap\|missing" tests/ README* 2>/dev/null; echo ----; cat tests/conftest.py; echo ----; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -15

python -m mypy src/ ; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; python -m ruff check src 2>&1 | tail -3; printf 'lat,lon,ele
0,0,
0,0.01,
' > $TMPDIR/allnone.csv; PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead $TMPDIR/allnone.csv 2>&1 | tail -3; printf 'lat,lon,ele
0,0,
0,0.01,100
0,0.02,
0,0.03,160
' > $TMPDIR/gap.csv; PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead $TMPDIR/gap.csv

PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead summary $TMPDIR/gap.csv; echo "exit=$?"; PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead summary $TMPDIR/allnone.csv 2>&1 | tail -2; echo "exit=$?"; python -m mypy src/ && git diff --stat
